annotations.title: Look Up Czech Company by IČO

description: Get a single Czech company record by its IČO (8-digit Business ID). Returns official name, registered address, legal form, VAT ID (DIČ), founding date, and trade license activities. Returns null if IČO is not found in ARES.

ico.description: Czech IČO — 7 or 8 digits. Examples: "11122234", "87654326". Auto-validated with MOD11 checksum.

name: lookup_by_ico
